# Codex app-server fixtures

These are **schema-conformant constructions, not live recordings.** No content was copied from anyone's native Codex histories.
Every notification in `*.jsonl` validates against the schema generated by the leased executable
(`schema/ServerNotification.json`); `tests/unit/test_activity_normalizers.py` checks that on every run.
The `*.golden.json` files pin the normalizer's output for each sequence.

## Runtime the names came from

| | |
|---|---|
| Executable | `/Users/danny/.local/share/codex-mcp-manager/releases/rust-v0.164.0-e147f02ecb40-1793009714936778000/bin/codex` |
| Version | `codex-cli 0.164.0` |
| SHA-256 | `3998a0e51bb7e4a2c8da905e9ba2f9e149c81ae44c487de59cf1e7296c04dadc` (the `codex` entry of `compat/runtime.json`) |
| Command | `CODEX_HOME=<empty temp dir> codex app-server generate-json-schema --experimental --out <dir>` |

The command submits no model input. `--experimental` matches the controller, which initializes with
`capabilities.experimentalApi: true`. The generator is deterministic: two runs produced identical bytes.
The experimental bundle holds 458 files and the stable bundle 320.

## What the normalizer uses

Server notifications (`ServerNotification.json`):

| Method | Params used | Activity |
|---|---|---|
| `item/started`, `item/completed` | `item` (`ThreadItem`), `startedAtMs`, `completedAtMs`, `turnId` | tool and message lifecycle |
| `item/agentMessage/delta` | `itemId`, `delta` | `message.delta` |
| `item/reasoning/summaryTextDelta` | `itemId`, `summaryIndex`, `delta` | `reasoning.delta` (a new `summaryIndex` starts a new paragraph) |
| `item/commandExecution/outputDelta` | `itemId`, `delta` | `tool.progress` (first 16 KiB per item) |
| `item/mcpToolCall/progress` | `itemId`, `message` | `tool.progress` |
| `item/fileChange/patchUpdated` | `itemId`, `changes` | latest changes kept for the completed item |
| `turn/plan/updated` | `plan[{step,status}]` | `plan.updated` |
| `thread/tokenUsage/updated` | `tokenUsage.total`, `tokenUsage.last` | `usage` (cumulative since the task's first update) |
| `thread/status/changed` | `status.type`, `status.activeFlags` | `task.state` (`waitingOnApproval` is `APPROVAL_BLOCKED`, `waitingOnUserInput` is `WAITING`) |
| `turn/completed` | `turn.status`, `turn.items` | `native_status` on `task.terminal`; unseen final `agentMessage` items become `message.completed` |

`ThreadItem` types mapped: `agentMessage`, `reasoning`, `commandExecution` (exec), `fileChange` (edit plus `files.changed`),
`mcpToolCall` (mcp), `webSearch` (web), `dynamicToolCall` (other), `collabAgentToolCall` (agent), `imageView` (read), `plan`.
Ignored without a gap: `userMessage`, `hookPrompt`, `functionCallOutput`, `contextCompaction`, `enteredReviewMode`,
`exitedReviewMode`, `subAgentActivity`, `sleep`, `imageGeneration`. Any other type becomes one `gap{reason:'unmapped'}` per task.
`item/reasoning/textDelta` and `reasoning.content` carry raw reasoning and are never recorded.

Steering: `ClientRequest.json` lists `turn/steer` (params `expectedTurnId`, `input`, `clientUserMessageId`) in both the stable
and the experimental bundle, next to `turn/interrupt` (params `threadId`, `turnId`). M2 relies on this for steer support.

## Sequences

| File | Covers |
|---|---|
| `completed-turn.jsonl` | reasoning summaries in two parts, a raw reasoning delta (must not be recorded), `commandExecution` with output deltas and exit code 0, `fileChange` (update and add) with `patchUpdated`, `mcpToolCall` with progress, `webSearch`, plan update, a commentary and a final streamed `agentMessage`, two token usage updates, `turn/completed` |
| `failed-turn.jsonl` | approval wait and resume, a command with exit code 2, a declined command, a failed MCP call, an `error` notification, `turn/completed` with status `failed` |
| `interrupted-turn.jsonl` | a command and a file change still open when `turn/completed` reports `interrupted` |

## Regenerating

Run the command above with the executable in `compat/runtime.json`, copy `ServerNotification.json` into `schema/`, update the
digests here, and rerun `tests/unit/test_activity_normalizers.py`. The `test_generated_schema_matches_the_recorded_digest`
test regenerates the bundle when that executable is present and fails if the digest moves, so a runtime update cannot change
these names unnoticed.
